scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && pnpm dev" "cd client && pnpm dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:types && pnpm build:api-client && pnpm build:web
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:types && pnpm typecheck:client && pnpm typecheck:server
scripts.test: echo 'Add tests with: pnpm test:web, pnpm test:api, pnpm test:python, pnpm test:cpp'
scripts.test:python: cd services/intelligence && python -m pytest tests/ -v || echo 'No Python tests'
scripts.test:cpp: cd native/audio-engine && cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test:api
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules packages/*/node_modules services/*/node_modules
scripts.postinstall: echo '✅ 4ang monorepo ready — run: pnpm dev'
